issue.title: SQL: Introduce SQL DATE data type

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Support ANSI SQL's DATE type by introducing a runtime-only
ES SQL date type.

Closes: #37340

issue.title: SQL: Fix casting from date to numeric type to use millis

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Previously casting from a DATE[TIME] type to a numeric (DOUBLE, LONG,
INT, etc. used seconds instead of the epoch millis.

Fixes: #37655
